data.narrative:
Observable Space, a Series A frontier space technology company founded by Dan Roelker and Rick Hedrick, has raised $90M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed) alongside public comparables including Rocket Lab, Planet Labs, Lunyr, AST SpaceMobile, and Satellogic trading at a median P/S of 24.4x.

Two methods triangulate to a discrete valuation range. Stage-progression analysis, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier from the $90M total raised proxy, implies $180M. Peer-median methodology across the three private comparables yields $1.3B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable due to lack of disclosed revenue. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $153M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $740M.

Key uncertainties include the comparability of the peer set—Observable Space's specific revenue traction and growth profile relative to Cowboy Space and Aalyria remain undisclosed—and the timing of next-stage funding relative to Series A entry valuation. The $587M spread between low and high estimates reflects stage and market-condition variance across the peer universe.
